"""Sweep Triton fused-trailing tiles (BM, BNc, NW, NS) on the EXACT n1024 trailing
workload, in isolation, to confirm the shipped (32,32,2,NS=3) is the local optimum
and that no tile fills SMs better (the grid is already saturated, so wider tiles
only REDUCE program count). NACC stays 1 (shipped)."""
import sys, os
import torch
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import reference as ref
import submission as sub
import triton

DEV = "cuda"; N = 1024; B = 60; BLK = 32
NITER = int(os.environ.get("ROOF_NITER", "80"))
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False


def build_panels(seed=75342, cond=2, case="dense"):
    data = ref.generate_input(B, N, cond, seed, case)
    A = data.clone(); H = data.clone()
    Vbuf = torch.empty((B, BLK, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
    Tbuf = torch.empty((B, BLK, BLK), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
    tau = torch.zeros((B, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
    sab, san = H.stride(0), H.stride(1)
    svb, svk, svn = Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(2)
    stb, stk, stn = Tbuf.stride(0), Tbuf.stride(1), Tbuf.stride(2)
    panels = []
    j = 0
    while j < N:
        b = min(BLK, N - j); pheight = N - j
        MAXH = triton.next_power_of_2(pheight); nwp = 8 if MAXH <= 1024 else 32
        if MAXH <= 256: nwp = 4
        src = A if j == 0 else H
        sub._panel_factor_kernel[(B,)](src, tau, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, j, pheight, b,
            sab, san, svb, svk, svn, stb, stk, stn, H, BLK=BLK, MAXH=MAXH, num_warps=nwp)
        ncols = N - (j + b)
        if ncols > 0:
            panels.append(dict(j=j, pheight=pheight, ncols=ncols,
                               V=Vbuf[:, :, j:j+pheight].contiguous(), T=Tbuf.clone(),
                               A=H[:, j:j+pheight, (j+b):N].contiguous()))
            nct_f = triton.cdiv(ncols, 32)
            sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct_f, B)](src, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, j, pheight, ncols, j+b,
                sab, san, svb, svk, svn, stb, stk, stn, H, BLK=BLK, BM=32, BNc=32,
                num_warps=2, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=1, NS=3)
        j += b
    return panels


def stage(panels):
    st = []
    for p in panels:
        Vbuf = torch.zeros((B, BLK, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
        Vbuf[:, :, p["j"]:p["j"]+p["pheight"]] = p["V"]
        Tbuf = p["T"].clone()
        Hbuf = torch.zeros((B, N, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
        b = min(BLK, N - p["j"])
        Hbuf[:, p["j"]:p["j"]+p["pheight"], (p["j"]+b):N] = p["A"]
        st.append((p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf))
    return st


def run_tile(st, BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC):
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ev0 = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True); ev1 = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
    # warmup compile
    for (p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf) in st:
        b = min(BLK, N - p["j"]); nct = triton.cdiv(p["ncols"], BNc)
        sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct, B)](Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, p["j"], p["pheight"],
            p["ncols"], p["j"]+b, Hbuf.stride(0), Hbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1),
            Vbuf.stride(2), Tbuf.stride(0), Tbuf.stride(1), Tbuf.stride(2), Hbuf,
            BLK=BLK, BM=BM, BNc=BNc, num_warps=NW, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=NACC, NS=NS)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ev0.record()
    for _ in range(NITER):
        for (p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf) in st:
            b = min(BLK, N - p["j"]); nct = triton.cdiv(p["ncols"], BNc)
            sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct, B)](Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, p["j"], p["pheight"],
                p["ncols"], p["j"]+b, Hbuf.stride(0), Hbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1),
                Vbuf.stride(2), Tbuf.stride(0), Tbuf.stride(1), Tbuf.stride(2), Hbuf,
                BLK=BLK, BM=BM, BNc=BNc, num_warps=NW, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=NACC, NS=NS)
    ev1.record(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return ev0.elapsed_time(ev1) / NITER * 1e3


if __name__ == "__main__":
    case = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "dense"
    panels = build_panels(case=case)
    st = stage(panels)
    print(f"=== n1024 trailing TILE SWEEP (case={case}, NITER={NITER}) ===")
    # (BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC)
    configs = [
        (32, 32, 2, 3, 1),    # SHIPPED
        (32, 32, 2, 1, 1),    # no pipeline
        (32, 32, 4, 3, 1),    # more warps
        (64, 32, 2, 3, 1),    # taller chunk
        (32, 64, 2, 3, 1),    # wider cols (fewer programs)
        (32, 64, 4, 3, 1),
        (64, 64, 4, 3, 1),
        (128, 32, 4, 3, 1),   # the big tile (accepted graft predecessor)
        (128, 64, 4, 1, 1),   # the old accepted big tile NS=1
        (32, 32, 2, 4, 1),    # deeper pipeline
        (32, 32, 2, 2, 1),
        (32, 32, 2, 3, 2),    # NACC=2 (brief says NACC stays 1 shipped; check)
        (16, 32, 2, 3, 1),    # shorter chunk -> more programs (more SM fill, more launches)
    ]
    base = None
    for (BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC) in configs:
        t = run_tile(st, BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC)
        tag = " <== SHIPPED" if (BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC) == (32, 32, 2, 3, 1) else ""
        if base is None and tag: base = t
        rel = f"{(t/base-1)*100:+.1f}%" if base else ""
        print(f"  BM={BM:>3} BNc={BNc:>3} NW={NW} NS={NS} NACC={NACC}: {t:8.1f} us  {rel}{tag}")

                               A=H[:, j:j+pheight, (j+b):N].contiguous()))
            nct_f = triton.cdiv(ncols, 32)
            sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct_f, B)](src, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, j, pheight, ncols, j+b,
                sab, san, svb, svk, svn, stb, stk, stn, H, BLK=BLK, BM=32, BNc=32,
                num_warps=2, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=1, NS=3)
        j += b
    return panels


def stage(panels):
    st = []
    for p in panels:
        Vbuf = torch.zeros((B, BLK, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
        Vbuf[:, :, p["j"]:p["j"]+p["pheight"]] = p["V"]
        Tbuf = p["T"].clone()
        Hbuf = torch.zeros((B, N, N), device=DEV, dtype=torch.float32)
        b = min(BLK, N - p["j"])
        Hbuf[:, p["j"]:p["j"]+p["pheight"], (p["j"]+b):N] = p["A"]
        st.append((p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf))
    return st


def run_tile(st, BM, BNc, NW, NS, NACC):
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ev0 = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True); ev1 = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
    # warmup compile
    for (p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf) in st:
        b = min(BLK, N - p["j"]); nct = triton.cdiv(p["ncols"], BNc)
        sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct, B)](Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, p["j"], p["pheight"],
            p["ncols"], p["j"]+b, Hbuf.stride(0), Hbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1),
            Vbuf.stride(2), Tbuf.stride(0), Tbuf.stride(1), Tbuf.stride(2), Hbuf,
            BLK=BLK, BM=BM, BNc=BNc, num_warps=NW, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=NACC, NS=NS)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ev0.record()
    for _ in range(NITER):
        for (p, Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf) in st:
            b = min(BLK, N - p["j"]); nct = triton.cdiv(p["ncols"], BNc)
            sub._trailing_fused_kernel[(nct, B)](Hbuf, Vbuf, Tbuf, B, N, p["j"], p["pheight"],
                p["ncols"], p["j"]+b, Hbuf.stride(0), Hbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1),
                Vbuf.stride(2), Tbuf.stride(0), Tbuf.stride(1), Tbuf.stride(2), Hbuf,
                BLK=BLK, BM=BM, BNc=BNc, num_warps=NW, IPREC="tf32x2", NACC=NACC, NS=NS)
    ev1.record(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return ev0.elapsed_time(ev1) / NITER * 1e3
